sql_fixes.why: Templated access names Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF (Skykomish RD), a Northwest Forest Pass, Mount Rainier NP and unrelated peaks (Persis, Gunn, Baring); none of that fits an Index Town Walls crag. Land check 2026-11-23: the Quarry's only coordinate (Mountain Project's area point 47.8191,-121.5703, not evidence) falls inside 'Forks of the Sky' State Park Property on the WA State Parks boundary layer, on Snohomish County parcel 27101900102500 owned by WA State Parks & Rec, and USFS basic ownership calls it NON-FS. But no independent source fixes where the wall sits: OSM has no Quarry/Country crag, and the park line is unclear here. USFS-owned Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF land begins about 150 m east (lng -121.5687), and a private inholding (parcel 27101900102100) cuts into the park about 150 m north-west, toward the Mid Wall where the Quarry tops out. The 2026-03-13 parks.wa.gov release names only the Lower Town Wall. So the known-wrong template is removed (access -> null), and the Forks of the Sky object ({land_manager: 'Washington State Parks (Forks of the Sky State Park)'}, live on wa_beetle_bailey_slab_flying_salamanders_short) is HELD until the wall's position is fixed. Held for the owner.
